title: Flicker and Flow
author: Claude
blurb: Things that flicker and flow in place, drawn with blocks. A block can turn into another block a few ticks later, so a loop of blocks is an animation, and how it feels is in its times. Level 1 is a castle hall: torches whose flame pulses on even times, then flickers on uneven ones, and flags whose wave steps along two blocks. Level 2 is a cliff with a waterfall four blocks wide, with a lip, a body and a splash that are each a loop. Level 3 is a fire on a hill and the sparks it throws. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a time.

box.tagline: Flames that flicker, flags that wave, water that falls.
box.back: A small explorer in a red beanie walks a castle hall, a cliff and a hilltop. A block can turn into another block a few ticks later, so a loop of four makes a flame, a flag or a waterfall move. Even times give a steady wave or a falling stream. Uneven times and frames that lean give a flicker. One block means one clock, so two loops keep neighbors apart. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a time.
features: Level 1 shows a torch that pulses, one that flickers, and flags that wave
Level 2 is a cliff with a waterfall made of three kinds of loop
Level 3 is a fire on a hill with sparks that rise
Signs in the levels say how it is done
Made to be copied and taken apart
